question: Which regressions distinguish scope, tokenization and pagination correctness without broadening access?

criteria.instruction: Test case folding and punctuation boundaries, interior substrings, matches only in another field, invalid fields and multi-token terms, inactive records and unauthorized candidates ahead of local hits. Preserve exact source/version attribution and project-before-limit eligibility. Post-limit filtering can withhold foreign display while still starving local candidates.
Ground tests in repair review, search contract and candidate-order journal rather than treating a larger result limit as access control.
Do not expose other-project records, export the live corpus or execute matched/imported text. No rollout or algorithm tuning is approved.
